event.distribution_pattern: Coverage is predominately the Midwest, specifically Nebraska, Iowa, Kansas, Colorado and South Dakota. Smaller concentration of stores in ND, WY, UT, OK, TX, MN and WI.

products.product_description: Dorothy Lynch Homestyle 8 oz., 16 oz., and 32 oz. bottles (12/case) and 128 oz. bottles (4/case)
products.product_quantity: 3617 12-8oz. bottle cases, 27218 12-16oz. bottle cases, 22241 12-32oz. bottle cases, and 9082 4-gallon cases
products.code_info: Affected Production Dates are: "Home Style 8, 16 or 32 oz. bottles: "Case dates between 12/22/16 and 4/11/16 are recalled. "Gallons with case dates between 12/28/2015 and 4/10/2016 are recalled. Affected Best By dates are: "Home Style 8, 16 or 32 oz. bottles: "Bottles with Best By dates between 9/19/16 and 1/7/16 are recalled. "Gallons with Best By dates between 6/16/16 and 10/11/16 are recalled.
products.reason_for_recall: The firm issued a press release on May 6, 2016, which encouraged consumers with affected bottles to return the product to the store for a refund. The recall will extend through the wholesale and retail distribution chain via scripted phone notification. The firm has informed distributors/retails to remove the product from shelves and track by using the best by date and sku. Products should be destroyed. The information has been posted on the firm website.
